summary: 130 facts added in 8 files (facts-faq-01.json to facts-faq-08.json), 0 left rejected after repair. 8 mechanical rejections were repaired and re-added (M9 volatility without changed: 3; M11 hard with an absolute word: 5). All FAQ facts are tier 2 (FAQ pages). The only conflict the tool queued for these facts is cf-0590 (the two Anycast Static IP counts, different use cases: close with --both). FAQ-versus-guide disagreements the tool did NOT queue are listed under 'discrepancies'.

discrepancies.faq_says: up to 3,000 individually invalidated objects and up to 15 wildcard paths in progress per distribution at one time
discrepancies.guide_says: cloudfront-limits table 'Quotas on invalidations': 150 paths or tags per second; 1 wildcard invalidation per second; no quota on files per wildcard or tag invalidation
discrepancies.rule: guide (tier 1) wins; do not teach the FAQ numbers

discrepancies.faq_says: 30 GB maximum size of a single file delivered through CloudFront
discrepancies.guide_says: 50 GB maximum cacheable file size per HTTP GET response (cloudfront-limits; RequestAndResponseBehaviorS3Origin and ...CustomOrigin 'Maximum cacheable file size')
discrepancies.rule: guide wins; the two statements measure different things (delivered file versus cacheable response body) so the writer must not state 30 GB as the limit

discrepancies.faq_says: IPv4 traffic towards all endpoints, IPv6 traffic towards Application Load Balancer endpoints
discrepancies.guide_says: docs/global-accelerator/latest/dg/WhatsNew document history: dual-stack accelerators; 'Adds support for dual-stack for Network Load Balancers'; 'IPv6 support for EC2 instances' (see changes-ga.txt for dates)
discrepancies.rule: guide wins; the FAQ sentence is out of date; the decisions+changes lens must mine the dated history rows

discrepancies.faq_says: relies on ELB for support for internal and non-AWS endpoints
discrepancies.guide_says: not checked in this lens; docs/global-accelerator/latest/dg/secure-vpc-connections is the page to compare (behavior lens)
discrepancies.rule: do not teach as a limit

discrepancies.faq_says: up to three Free plans per AWS account
discrepancies.rule: agree; the registrar should merge the two (keep the guide fact, tier 1)

discrepancies.note: cloudfront-faq-functions-complement-lambda-edge and cloudfront-faq-lambda-edge-for-heavy-computation overlap cloudfront-dec-functions-not-replacing-lambda-edge; cloudfront-faq-field-level-encryption-private-keys-decrypt overlaps cloudfront-dec-fle-only-apps-with-private-keys-decrypt; cloudfront-faq-secure-origin-oac-supported-origins overlaps cloudfront-dec-ddos-wp-oac-for-s3-elemental-lambda-url. Same sentences quoted from different pages or the same page; the registrar merges.
